Our Story

When ComForCare opened its first location in Michigan in 1996, in-home senior care was just an emerging industry. We saw a need—families were struggling to find reliable, high-quality care for their aging loved ones.

Over the last three decades, we have grown from a single location into a trusted nationwide network. We pioneered thorough training programs to ensure franchise owners and caregivers could provide the highest level of service. Today, we continue to lead the industry by creating innovative programs that address the evolving needs of the aging population, ensuring that everyone in the family receives the support they deserve.
Our 30th Anniversary

Dynamic Company Culture

Our mission is to help others live their best life possible.
ComForCare has five core values that drive everything we do:
  • Care Like Family

When your loved one needs extra support at home, our professional caregivers make aging in place comfortable and safe

  • Serve Passionately

Our professional caregivers help your loved one to maintain independence with respect and dignity.

  • Dignity Matters

Our caregivers serve passionately, with empathy and a true connection to your loved one.

  • Be Present And Engaged

With intentional actions and compassionate support, our caregivers address their clients' needs, provide reassurance, and create a nurturing environment that promotes well-being.

  • Have Fun

With a positive attitude, our professional caregivers change the lives of older adults by making daily activities fun.

Living our values is how ComForCare stands out in the communities we serve. It’s how ComForCare and our franchise owners have raised the bar and set new standards for innovative, quality non-medical and skilled in-home care.

National Collaboration with Parkinson's Foundation

In 2026, we are launching a powerful new initiative: supporting the Parkinson's Foundation by forming a national team. While there are many wonderful organizations in this space, we align with the Foundation and Moving Day on a national level because of their unwavering commitment to education, awareness, and research. Their relentless dedication to developing tools and resources makes an incomparable impact.

ComForCare/At Your Side is committed to raising funds for a cause at the heart of our mission: helping those with Parkinson’s disease live the best life possible. This is achieved not only through specialized care via our Parkinson's Pathway program but also by supporting the Parkinson’s Foundation’s commitment to the Parkinson's community. We have also joined forces with our sister brand, CarePatrol.com, which shares our dedication to this cause. By forming joint teams, we aren’t just sharing the effort—we’re amplifying our impact. Together, our national team has committed to participating in nine walks with a collective fundraising goal of $50,000.

FAQ

A home care agency provides professional support and assistance that allows individuals to continue living safely and comfortably at home. Services often include help with daily activities like bathing, dressing, meal preparation, medication reminders, mobility support, companionship, and specialized programs for conditions such as dementia. The goal is to promote independence, dignity, and quality of life for clients while giving peace of mind to their families.

A home care agency delivers care in the comfort of your own home, while nursing homes require moving into a residential facility. Home care agencies focus on personalized, one-on-one support tailored to each client’s needs and routines. This means your loved one can remain in familiar surroundings, maintain independence, and receive flexible care — from just a few hours a week to 24/7 assistance — without the disruption of relocating to an institution.

When choosing a home care agency, look for:

  • Experience and reputation in the community
  • Specialized programs for conditions like dementia or chronic illness
  • Caregiver training and screening processes
  • Personalized care plans that adapt as needs change
  • Transparent communication and ongoing support for families

ComForCare stands out because of our DementiaWise® program, caregiver-first philosophy, and commitment to treating every client like family.

ComForCare is a nationwide home care agency with franchise locations across the United States and Canada. Each local office is independently owned and operated, but all follow the same high standards of care, training, and support. To find out if ComForCare serves your community, you can use our location finder or contact us directly for assistance.
